records.name: Brockwell Park
records.location: Brockwell Park, Norwood Road, Herne Hill, Lambeth London SE24 9BJ.
records.description: Lambeth Council says Brockwell Park normally closes shortly before sunset, but Friends of Brockwell Park report that gates stopped being locked from November 2024. This unresolved access discrepancy should be verified at the park; Splashd does not provide dated current cruising testimony.
records.original_source_description: Way in after closure is via Brockwell Lido Carpark. Cruising is either directly to the left in the bushes by the miniature rail tracks, or walk straight up to tennis courts and bowling green. Cruisiest shrubbery to left of entrance, up by BMX Track.

records.description: City of London verifies this public part of Epping Forest is open 24 hours and includes protected habitat and playing fields. Splashd's claimed cruising spots are not verified by a recent participant's account.

records.name: Burgess Park
records.location: Burgess Park, Albany Road, Southwark London SE5.
records.description: Southwark describes the main Burgess Park as always open, whereas the carpark and specific nature/garden areas are seasonally gated. The archived Splashd cruising label supplies no dated eyewitness since the cutoff.
